node.title: Finite row-sharp Q shortcut route cuts
node.statement: At the four deployed rows: ordinary full-mass moment proofs need orders 94196, 94991, 641593, and 680397; after pruning the exact necessary condition is r(Delta_Q-log2 tau)>=w log2|B|, so the full-mass numbers cannot be reused without tau. The proved Q packing ceiling is over 1.66 million bits too weak, and the one-pencil moving-root theorem does not directly pay the 913633--913682 dimensional boundary-Q slices without an exhaustive counted pencil cover.
node.notes: Roadmap N4 core import from upstream main@32a41660. These are route cuts only. Specialized Route-D no-go packages remain unimported until an exact current local consumer and partition crosswalk are supplied.
